ImageDescription.value: Panorama image of the town of Rauma, Finland on 24th December, 2004. The view is from a hill towards town centre and the Old Rauma. On the left, one can see the cranes and the grain repository of the harbour of Rauma. The Old Rauma is located to the left of the white church in the right half of the image. On the right, in the horizon, one can make out the twin buildings of Olkiluoto nuclear power plant.
